# Paw & Prosper

> SEO and AI visibility specialists for animal wellness businesses. We help veterinarians, pet brands, animal shelters, and animal rescues get found on Google and recommended by AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity.

Founded by Samantha Quinones, a digital marketing strategist specializing in SEO and AI visibility systems for the animal wellness industry.

## Services

- [SEO & AI Visibility Services](https://pawandprosper.com/services): Overview of all service offerings including local SEO, LLM optimization, and content strategy.
- [Veterinary Clinic SEO](https://pawandprosper.com/seo-for-veterinary-clinics): Specialized SEO and AI visibility for independent veterinary practices competing with corporate chains like VCA, Banfield, and National Veterinary Associates.
- [Animal Shelter SEO & Marketing](https://pawandprosper.com/seo-for-animal-shelters): SEO and digital marketing for animal shelters to attract more adopters, donors, and volunteers through search and AI.
- [Animal Rescue SEO](https://pawandprosper.com/seo-for-animal-rescues): SEO and AI optimization for foster-based and breed-specific rescue organizations to increase adoptions, foster recruitment, and donor support.
- [Pet Brand SEO](https://pawandprosper.com/seo-for-pet-brands): SEO and AI visibility for pet product brands and e-commerce companies wanting organic growth that doesn't depend on paid ads.
- [Pet Services SEO](https://pawandprosper.com/seo-for-pet-services): Local SEO and AI visibility for groomers, trainers, boarding facilities, daycare, and holistic pet wellness businesses.

## Case Studies

- [Lone Star Animal Welfare League: 32x Google Visibility Growth](https://pawandprosper.com/how-lone-star-animal-welfare-league-grew-google-visibility-32x-in-six-months-no-ad-spend): How LSAWL, a shelter and rescue nonprofit in Bryan-College Station, TX, grew search visibility 32x in six months with no paid ad spend.
